(kya waseela jayaz hai,is ki daleel kya hai,please give it.) Question: Whether waseelah is jayez? what is the Proof? Please, explain. (kya waseela jayaz hai,is ki daleel kya hai,please give it.) Answer ID: 3805 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 786/602=H) It is allowed: ولما جاءھم کتاب من عند اللہ مصدق لما معھم و کانوا من قبل یستفتحون علی الذین کفروا ( القرآن الکریم، سورۃ البقرۃ ) Under this verse, Allama Syed Mahmood Aalusi writes that before the advent of Islam the Jews in their fights against the kuffar tribes used to pray for their victory with the waseelah (mediation) of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ). Even they used to pray by putting their fingers at the places in Torah where the names of the Prophet ( صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم ) were mentioned: اللھم انا نس أ لک بحق نبیک الذی وعدتنا أن تبعثہ فی آخر الزمان أن تنصرنا علی عدونا ا ھ ( تفسیر روح المعانی: 1/289، تفسیر الدر المنثور: 1/88 ) . For more details, see: Bukhari, Tirmizi, Abn Majah, Tabrani etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
